messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] P1 Alerts: sustained 5xx + 429 surge on Dedicated inference in eu-central-1 during canary of release/2026.03.smallpatch-quantize. Alert rule: runner-inference-errors > 3% over 4m. Affected: inference-gateway-dedicated. Page: zara.oncall

zara.oncall: ack. I'm live. Anyone on the quantize change?

mika-releases: that canary introduced a tiny kernel-selection tweak (single commit in PR #4395) that prefers fp16-quant kernels for small-batch paths. Intention was perf improvement only.

tom.sre: seeing gateway 503s and 429s throttled by runner. Quick log peek: `kubectl -n inference logs deploy/inference-runner-canary | tail -n 40` shows `ERROR decode_proto: unexpected EOF` followed by `panic: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference`. Looks like malformed payload handling in the quant kernel path.

liu-support: customer hits: DataLeap reported 15% failed calls for ~6m, FinGate reported intermittent 503s on their health checks. I'm drafting a customer note.

zara.oncall: we need to stop traffic to the canary ASAP. Options: gate flag, scale to zero, or cut revert. Which is fastest?

mika-releases: we have a runtime gate flag `quant_kernel_smallbatch` (console: https://console.redwood.internal/flags/quant_kernel_smallbatch). Flip it off for eu-central-1 first while we make a revert.

zara.oncall: ops-bot, run flag toggle.

ops-bot: Running `flagsctl set quant_kernel_smallbatch false --env=prod --regions=eu-central-1`

ops-bot: Done. Flag set to false in eu-central-1.

tom.sre: Error rate drops within one minute from 3.9% -> 0.7%. Gateway 503s subside. Good.

liu-support: sent interim message to DataLeap and FinGate: "We detected elevated errors during a canary; we have disabled the canary kernel flag in eu-central-1 and are rolling back the change. No customer data was exposed."

mika-releases: I'll open a revert PR to remove the commit entirely so we don't reintroduce this by mistake during future rollouts. Revert command: `git revert --no-edit d4f7e99` -> PR #4399.

zara.oncall: do it. Also please run a quick smoke test against small-prompt workload once reverted.

build-bot: PR 4399 created by mika-releases. CI: running (unit/integration/smoke).

tom.sre: adding temporary rate-limit on canary pods to reduce burst retries while we wait: `kubectl scale deploy/inference-runner-canary --replicas=1 -n inference`

mika-releases: CI green, merging PR 4399 now. Merge done. Triggering rollout to replace canary image with stable.

ops-bot: Rollout command: `deployctl rollout --service=inference-runner --to-image=repo/inference:stable --canary` executed. Canary progressing in three waves.

tom.sre: logs on new canary look clean. No decode errors. 5xx/429 under threshold.

zara.oncall: preliminary timeline: 2026-04-02T09:05Z canary started; error spike 09:09Z; flag kill 09:14Z; revert PR merged 09:28Z; stable canary by 09:34Z. Impacted window ~9 minutes before mitigation.

liu-support: update: DataLeap reported ~12 failed requests/minute at peak for ~7 minutes. FinGate saw intermittent checks fail but recovered after flag flip. Both customers acknowledged the interim note; no SLA penalties claimed yet.

mika-releases: filing issue runner/bug#1024 with stack trace and small repro. Also adding a test case to catch malformed proto path in the quant kernel.

zara.oncall: handing off monitoring to tom.sre for 6h. tom, you good to watch alerts and escalate if regression?

tom.sre: taking it. I'll be on pager. If anything reappears, I'll ping `@eng-oncall-lead`.

incident-bot: Incident resolved (auto): condition clear for 20m. Summary: P1 mitigated by disabling kernel flag + single-commit revert. Customers: DataLeap, FinGate. Postmortem owner: mika-releases. Follow-ups: runner/bug#1024, PR4399 revert.

zara.oncall: thanks team, closing thread. I'll attach metric graphs and customer notes to the postmortem doc. (reacts :white_check_mark:)
